title: Coforge Revenue Rises 54% as AI Engineering and Deal Bookings Gain Momentum
script:
Coforge revenue just grew 53.6 percent year-on-year.
CEO Sudhir Singh says AI engineering is driving this record deal momentum.
The firm secured fresh order intake of 1.04 billion dollars this quarter.
Coforge integrated generative AI tools into their core IT service operations.
This growth reflects a significant increase in client demand for AI expertise.
The firm now operates with a total headcount of over 30,000 employees.
Their AI engineering services are now a primary revenue engine for the business.
Would you trust an AI to manage your company IT?
